visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with black hair wearing a white and grey striped t-shirt stands in a modern living room. He gestures energetically with his hands while speaking directly to the camera. Behind him, a tuxedo cat sits on a low, modern coffee table. The background features a large beige sofa and light wood paneling. (2) The man leans over an orange tabby cat lying on a fluffy beige rug. He uses a smartphone to take close-up photos of the cat's underside while poking its belly with his other hand. Comic-style white radial lines burst from the center of the frame for emphasis. (3) The man holds his phone up to the orange cat again, framing a shot. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting the cat's fur texture. (4) A stylized graphic appears showing a cat's face superimposed on an anime-style character wearing a blue and white school uniform dress. The background is a pastel-colored sky with sparkles. (5) The man is now seen holding a solid white cat with green eyes. He speaks with a neutral expression. (6) The man, now wearing a black t-shirt with a graphic print, sits on the floor. He holds up two custom-made pillows: one shaped like a long, distorted orange cat and another like a white cat. (7) He holds the orange cat pillow and compares it to the real orange cat. A fire-like digital effect appears around the man's head as he makes an exaggerated, energetic face. (8) He holds the white cat pillow next to the real white cat, then shows a pillow with a tuxedo cat's face sitting next to the real tuxedo cat on a table. (9) The screen transitions to mobile game footage of 'Tree of Savior M'. Animated characters with large eyes run through various environments (beach, forest, dungeon) accompanied by small cat and dog pets. High-contrast colorful skill effects explode on screen. (10) The man returns to the frame holding the orange cat, pointing aggressively at the camera with a wide smile and high energy.

A subtle 'whoosh' SFX signals a scene transition. (2) A sharp 'ding' and comedic 'boing' sound effects are inserted as the speaker mocks the appearance of cat pillows. The BGM maintains its high energy, and the speaker's tone remains humorous and enthusiastic. (3) A series of rapid-fire 'impact' sound effects sync with visual 'bang' lines. The speaker's volume increases during comedic emphasis. The room tone is very clean, indicating high-quality recording. (4) The audio texture shifts during the game segment; the BGM swells, and high-frequency 'chime' and 'slash' game sounds are layered over the continuous narration. The speaker's delivery becomes even more persuasive and rapid. (5) The final segment features a loud, triumphant 'sting' sound effect and an energetic vocal crescendo as the speaker delivers a call to action. The BGM remains present until the very end.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video uses a humorous vlog format about making 'ugly' cat pillows to create a relatable hook for pet owners. It then seamlessly transitions into promoting the mobile game 'Tree of Savior M' by highlighting its pet system and custom items, encouraging viewers to download the game to interact with pet 'stars'.
